Italian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈbaɲ.ɲo/
  • Audio (il bagno):(file)
  • Audio:(file)
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -aɲɲo
  • Hyphenation: bà‧gno

Etymology 1

[edit]

Inherited from Latin baneum, variant of balneum.

Noun

[edit]

bagno m (plural bagni)

  1. bath
  2. swim, bathe
  3. bathroom
    Synonyms: stanza da bagno, sala da bagno, toilette
  4. (historical) ellipsis of bagno penale; penal colony
    Synonym: ergastolo
Derived terms
[edit]
  • bagnetto
  • bagno di folla
  • bagno di sangue
  • bagno penale
  • bagno turco
  • bagnomaria
  • bagnoschiuma
  • bellezza al bagno
  • costume da bagno
  • sali da bagno
  • vasca da bagno
Related terms
[edit]
  • bagnare
  • balneare
Descendants
[edit]
  • → Albanian: banjo
  • → Amharic: ባኞ (banyo)
  • → English: bagnio
  • → French: bagne
  • → Greek: μπάνιο (bánio)
  • → Hijazi Arabic: بانيو (bānyu)
  • → Ottoman Turkish: بانیو (banyo), بانه (bana), بانیه (banya)
    • Turkish: banyo
    • → Armenian: պանեօ (paneō)
    • → Laz: ბანჲო (banyo)

bagno

  1. first-person singular present indicative of bagnare

Kashubian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Proto-Slavic *bagno.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈbaɡ.nɔ/
  • Rhymes: -aɡnɔ
  • Syllabification: bag‧no

Noun

[edit]

bagno m inan

  1. swamp
  2. sow (female pig/suid)

Old Polish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Proto-Slavic *bagno. First attested in 1426.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (10th–15th CE) /baɡnɔ/
  • IPA(key): (15th CE) /baɡnɔ/

Noun

[edit]

bagno n

  1. (attested in Greater Poland) swamp
    • 1930 [c. 1455], “Ex”, in Ludwik Bernacki, editor, Biblia królowej Zofii (Biblia szaroszpatacka)‎transliteration, transcription, 8, 5:
      Wsczyøgny røkøø swø nad rzekamy... y nad bagny (super fluvios... et paludes)
      [Wściągni rękę swą nad rzekami... i nad bagny (super fluvios... et paludes)]
    • c. 1500, Wokabularz lubiński, Lubiń: inkunabuł Archiwum Archidiecezjalnego w Gnieźnie, sygn. Inc. 78d., page 75v:
      Limus est terra humida et tenosa proprie leym bągno
      [Limus est terra humida et tenosa proprie leym bągno]
  2. wild rosemary, Rhododendron tomentosum
    • 1900 [1437], Józef Rostafiński, editor, Symbola ad historiam naturalem medii aevi = Średniowieczna historya naturalna w Polsce. Ps 2‎[2], number 2813:
      Bagno tamariscus
      [Bagno tamariscus]
  3. hare's-tail cottongrass (Eriophorum vaginatum)
    • 1900 [1472], Józef Rostafiński, editor, Symbola ad historiam naturalem medii aevi = Średniowieczna historya naturalna w Polsce. Ps 2‎[3], number 885:
      Bagno gramen album
      [Bagno gramen album]
  4. common heather (Calluna vulgaris)
    Synonym: wrzos
    • 1885-2024 [End of the 15th century], Jan Baudouina de Courtenay, Jan Karłowicz, Antoni Adam Kryńskiego, Malinowski Lucjan, editors, Prace Filologiczne‎[4], volume V, page 9:
      Bagno vel orosz mirica
      [Bagno vel wrzos mirica]
    • XV p. post., Wokabularz petersburski II, Cesarskiej Biblioteki Publicznej w Petersburgu, sygn. Lat.F.ch.XVI.12, page 9:
      Mirica bagno vel *orosz
      [Mirica bagno vel *orosz]
  5. (attested in Lesser Poland) The meaning of this term is uncertain. Possibilities include:
    1. heather, plant of the family Ericaceae
      • 1874-1891 [End of the 15th century], Rozprawy i Sprawozdania z Posiedzeń Wydziału Filologicznego Akademii Umiejętności‎[5], [6], [7], volume LIII, Krakow, page 63:
        Adde herbam dictam in vulgari bagno
        [Adde herbam dictam in vulgari bagno]

nouns

Polish

[edit]
Polish Wikipedia has an article on:
bagno
Wikipedia pl

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Old Polish bagno.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • IPA(key): /ˈbaɡ.nɔ/
  • (Middle Polish) IPA(key): /ˈbaɡ.nɔ/
  • (Lesser Poland):
    • (Goral):
      • (Żywiec) IPA(key): [ˈbaɡ.nɔ]
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -aɡnɔ
  • Syllabification: bag‧no

Noun

[edit]

bagno n (diminutive bagienko, augmentative bagnisko, related adjective bagienny)

  1. swamp, marsh, bog
    Synonyms: błocisko, błoto, grzęzawisko, moczar, mokradło, trzęsawisko
  2. (colloquial) mud
    Synonyms: błocisko, błotko, błoto
  3. marsh rosemary (Rhododendron tomentosum and the whole Rhododendron subsect. Ledum)
    bagno zwyczajne ― marsh tea
  4. quagmire (demoralizing situation)
    Synonym: błoto
  5. (Middle Polish) willow (any of various deciduous trees or shrubs in the genus Salix, in the willow family Salicaceae)
    Synonym: wierzba
  6. (Middle Polish, hunting) den, lair (animal's dwelling space, especially a boar's)
    Synonym: legowisko
  7. (Żywiec) soaked dung

Declension

[edit]
Declension of bagno
singular plural
nominative bagno bagna
genitive bagna bagien
dative bagnu bagnom
accusative bagno bagna
instrumental bagnem bagnami
locative bagnie bagnach
vocative bagno bagna
